name: complete-remaining-control-plane-proof-capabilities
title: Complete remaining control-plane and proof capability gaps
description: Resolve the seven remaining control-plane/proof capability gaps after B-cd3a and B-edb8. The story must first verify whether each capability is already covered or should be retired, then add red/diagnostic coverage before implementation. Scope includes Tier-C cleanup policy resolution, append-only admissibility ledger decision or implementation, queue cleanup enforcement, runtime closure enforce rollout, broader CommandSpec envelope coverage, project-level consumption waterline rollup, and retired Authority vocabulary cleanup. Authority Server conformance is retired and must not remain future backlog.
